quote_text: Sachin would later go on to say that I did not sleep well for the past 12 nights I have been thinking about this for more than a year now Everywhere I went, people reminded me about this MATCH today We are gonna tell the story of that match A do or die match In a world cup Against pakistan with nearly unsurmountable total a match where Harbhajan and Yousuf had nearly come to blow a match where after which Shahid Afridi would get banned for sledging a match before which Shoaib Akhtar openly challenged Sachin today we hear the Legend of Centurion 28 February 2003 A day before the India Pakistan match the nervousness in the Indian dressing room was nearly palpable Now even by itself an India Pakistan Match is a pressure cooker situation But this was the first match against them After the 2000 parliament attack After which we had banned all cricket against Pakistan So, this match was being viewed as a quest for vengeance The pressure faced by this team unimaginable especially since for whatever reason they seemed to have forgotten how to play ODIs… First a home loss to West Indies Then a 2 to 5 defeat to New Zealand And then losing to a South African club team In a warm up match for world cup & as if that wasn’t humiliating enough We could not even play out 50 overs against Netherland While Australia bungled us out for just 125 runs That was the lowest score made by India in a world cup and the 7th lowest among the top test playing nations The outcry that this loss had caused back home was so massive That Sachin had to call for a press conference mid way into the world cup Asking the fans to calm down a bit And even though we won the next match against England it had taken an superhuman effort from the Ashish Nehra to pull that off So, all in all Things weren’t looking good For this Indian squad And now they were going to face Pakistan Who not only had the highest wicket taking bowler in this tournament But also Shoaib Akhtar Who had gone out of his way To challenge Sachin yesterday "Against India, I'm gonna go after the bigger names, I'm not gonna make it easier for them." "If I run in well, if I've the rhythm, Then I don't care who is at the  other end, Ponting or Sachin." So - You can understand Why the faces of the entire team looked as if they were in some mourning or something Forget about players even the coach was nervous to the point that he would start impromptu coaching session Whenever he met someone Play with discipline, controlled cricket. Allow the opposition to self-destruct. This had gotten to the point that the captain Ganguly actually blurted out in a meeting "One of these days, someone will have a heart attack. But facing this gloomy atmosphere The youngsters Yuvraj and Sehwag they had finally had enough they began teasing the captain The captain also responded in kind Smilingly saying that kids don't respect their elders these days. And this after a span of weeks finally caused some laughter in the squad The same mood would carried forward on the next day On one hand - As the entire team got together ahead of time for breakfast Hoping to reach the ground early But on the other hand You had Mohammad Kaif Playing table tennis in a corner asking the number 1 seed Sachin to join in Sachin though he was in the world of his own Specifically he was in the same place he had been for the past one year since this match was announced Wherever he went Everybody would remind him of this match Pleading with him Begging him He had to win No matter what Such was the pressure of these expectations That for the first time The man who had played countless finals Faced down the fiercest of opponents stood tall against unsurmountable odds He just couldn’t sleep He had spent the last 2 weeks tossing and turning in bed Imagining and reimagining playing out the entire match in his head Each and every night So, as he finished his breakfast. while the rest of the team went and sat in the bus That was already loaded with their kit Sachin Ran back to his room Because unlike everybody He had decided to keep his bat close to him In his room through the night Now what exactly was he doing with it nobody knows Whether he kept it beside his pillow or shadow batted through the night nobody knows But as he was returning He saw Dada, Sehwag and Dravid Rushing back to their rooms Apparently - he wasn’t the only one who couldn’t bear to be part with his bat As the team made its way to the ground They had a few surprises waiting for them The first Pakistani team was already there before them Apparently Sachin wasn’t the only one having a difficult time sleeping But the bigger problem was the second surprise the match referee Procter had informed both sides A small friendship event was to take place right before the start of the match Both the sides would come to the ground And exchange some gifts Apparently, the team management had agreed to this a long time back With the players being completely in the dark about it And this caused sparks Indian senior players quickly asked this is just another game right? why must we make a statement? Why is the ICC behaving like the UN all of a sudden? But as the journalists had started gathering below and the match was getting delayed They had no choice but to relent And that is where we got this iconic photo from From an event Which was opposed by many on the Indian side Either ways though The formalities were out of the way finally the main course could begin a main course that very quickly cause the entire Indian team to have indigestion Saeed Anwar had decided to put a masterclass on aggressive batting by the time the class ended Pakistan had raced to 273 runs now let me put the enormity of this score in perspective by that time while chasing in a world cup the best India had ever done was 222 in fact only twice in the history of world cup till this point was a score larger than this chased and now India had to pull this off against Pakistan in a do or die match as you can guess morale was low and tempers they were flying high and one of the person with this high temper was Harbhajan singh having been kept out of  this match by the selectors all he could do was watch helplessly from the dugout as India was pushed out of the match Bhajji angry beyond belief tried to cool off by going to the lunch area common to both teams and sitting there were Mohammad Yousuf and Wasim Akram Now it initially started off as just fun banter guys just sitting down poking ribbing having fun with each other But this players were from india and pakistan There won't be any defeats allowed even while joking Hence both players… kept on trying to one up each other Trying to get the better of the other and it was during this That Yousuf said something about Harbhajan's religion And that sent Bhajji off He got up screaming expletives and Yousuf followed suit things then quickly escalated to the point that both the players were walking towards each other forks in hands Thankfully seniors from both the sides quickly intervened pulling the players back to their dugouts so yes facing a near sure defeat to Pakistan things inside the dressing room were as bad as they could get the only chance being the plan devised by the captain and coach it was pretty straightforward don’t lose wickets in the first 10 just play them out calmly and then we will attack after and both the openers readily agreed to it even Sehwag with his ponchont of aggressive batting understood the severity of the situation and complied as the openers set foot on the ground The whole stadium was suddenly shaken by cheers Because Sachin Had come out to open Sachin with bags under his eyes with his weapon in his hand And the hopes of a billion people on his shoulders He took the field And played the first over Exactly according to the plan But then the next over It was gonna have the express taking the ball The assassin that had promised to take his scalp And had also become the fastest baller in the world just two days back He now seemed raring to go Which was plain to see as right after the first ball He decided to go and start sledging Sehwag Abe oye Try to hit a hook Common Try to hit a hook Sehwag Who was already irritated Because of having to suppress his natural game and on top of that what happened to Bhajji So He quickly replied You see that there On the opposing end Waha tera baap khada hai your daddy is standing there Go and tell him to play a hook Now even though Shoaib Akhtar has denied this happening It's curious that the very next ball The 4th ball of the over Would be balled short In an attempt to invite that very same hook And so would begin…. those 3 shots The 3 shots that would later come to define this match And would serve as a proof of Sachin’s greatness Because by that time by that 4th ball According to Sachin He was feeling so good that balls close to 150 kmph were looking like 130 kmph So rather then sticking to the plan He decided If it is there to hit, I will hit it And so He quickly pounced on the wayward bouncer Shoaib Akhtar at that moment Was feeling the same thing million of fans back home were feeling Right at that moment - something had changed As if a monster in slumber Had suddenly woken up Sombre Shoaib quickly made his way back to the starting point this time bowling a good line and length Hoping to test the monster But swirling wrist would see the ball quickly dispatched to the square leg boundary 5 balls – 14 runs And one ball to go in the battle of the bat and ball not only had the bat drawn first blood But it had completely banished the ball So, Shoaib Akhtar had to take back control He had to earn some respect right now Or else The monster would go on a rampage So he bowled the last ball with everything he had The response out of the crease No back-lift no follow-through just a simple block and the ball down the ground for four. Till date This is one of the most picturesque moment I have ever seen Like a painting Sachin, Shoaib and the stadium with that the destruction was complete Shoaib’s first over had gone for 18 runs After which he was promptly taken off of attack Sachin had neutralised one of the most dangerous bowlers in the world now he was on the hunt To gobble up any hapless prey who would dare to stand in his way Wasim Akram being hit for 21 in 3 Waqar Younis going for 11 in his first India Would raise to 50 in the first 5 overs Before each ball Ganguly would hold onto the amulets Praying in nervousness And then he would smile wryly as the ball raced to the boundary blowing his plan in smithereens Sachin would later say That I had no plans of actually batting that way there was no question of targeting shoaib I was actually gonna stick to the plan but you have to be prepared to change them, when things change out in the middle. It was just one of those days. One of those days where in spite of wickets falling on the other end Sachin Kept on scoring at a blistering pace Reaching 50 in just 37 balls Building a 100 run partnership with kaif And completing 1200 odi runs in the process But By this time His body with weeks of sleepless nights And days of constant pressure Was showing the fatigue Sachin suddenly started suffering from cramps It was so painful That Sachin just couldn’t move anymore And yet Sachin just grit his teeth and kept on playing on and on For 10 overs straight Stumbling, limping falling down and then getting up and carrying on till his body just gave out and he got out Just two runs away from his century With India 99 runs away from the target With nearly half the overs to go now on paper this seems easy right? Especially with 6 wickets left This had be a cakewalk So for all intent and purposes Sachin had won this match for his country And whenever a player returns with such an outstanding performance He is met with cheers and applause and ovations at the dugout But on that day As a limping sachin Slowly made his way back to the dressing room he was met With complete silence he came in And Sat down on a stool away from everyone his eyes blankly staring ahead His shirt completely drenched in sweat His breathing laboured The heartbreak, The disappointment of not finishing plain to see on his face Coz In his heart Even he knew India was in trouble The adage of India being a one man army had been proven time and again by this team they had lost from much better position to even worse depths So, the moment sachin got out he was filled with guilt at his failure He simply sat there Watching his dismissal on tv again and again While his team sat and watched him silently Again and again and finally the coach John Wright had had enough he got up walked upto Sachin and simply patted his back and this as if breaking the trance people quickly came up and started removing Sachin's pads while the captain standing at the balcony looking sachin in his eyes and clapping silently in spite of what Sachin felt he had done what he had to do he had done everything that we could and now it was the team's turn to return that favour and thankfully gratefully his team obliged Dravid and Yuvraj in a move to conserve wickets Simply started playing test cricket where sachin’s 98 had come in 75 balls The final hundred took 20 overs In what looked like a tag team race The first part being conquered by the hare Cutting and slashing every which way While the second part becoming the domain of the turtle Slowly but surely winning the race For Pakistan Its next match would be washed off Knocking them out of the world cup in the group stage itself Vice captain Inzamam ul Haq would tender his resignation right then and there The captain would be fired Just a few days later Along with the coach Team manager selection committee and 8 players of the team Players including Wasim Akram Saeed anwar And Shoaib Akhtar For India As the entire team would come out to attend the post match ceremony The cheers that greeted Sachin’s limping entry Would have been enough to turn any man deaf & As the celebration on the ground ended the celebration in the dressing room began With players stamping on beer cans While taking the names of their  favourite critics Sachin would be found in a corner Calling back home to his wife Who picked up the phone and simply put it out of the window Letting Sachin hear a Diwali being celebrated in March…. The captain on the other hand He too was in a corner He too along with a phone But on the other end Was the Chief of Army Staff for India Who had somehow gotten hold of his number Wanting to congratulate the team This then was the story of the match that till date Sachin, Sehwag, Yuvraj and Dravid call one of the most important matches of their career The match Later went on to be known As the Legend of the Centurion. Thank you for watching this video I hope you enjoyed this video I hope that you have a good day Thank you for watching.
